headlines.summary: 중소벤처硏, 기업동향 분석 결과 3분기 중기 수출 334억불 최고치 제조업 생산은 전년대비 4% 감소 대출연체 증가…고용·창업도 부진 중소기업계가 역대 최고 수출 실적에도 불구하고 제조업 부진이 이어지고 있다. 사진은 한 섬유공장 모습. [연합] 중소기업 수출이 역대 3분기 최대 실적을 기록했지만 제조업 생산은 감소세로 돌아선 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.summary: 1~9월 국세수입 385조원…전년比 33%↑ 9월 법인세 중간예납 분납분 등 23.6조↑ 재추계 대비 진도율 80.5%…추경比 92.7% "높은 진도율만으로 추가 세수 판단 어려워" [서울=뉴시스] [세종=뉴시스]여동준 기자 = 반도체 기업의 실적 개선에 따른 법인세 증가 등에 힘입어 올해 9월까지 국세수입이 지난해보다 95조4000억원 늘었다.

headlines.title: 민주당 " 가상자산 과세 결론까지 고시 미뤄야…당 입장 조속히 정리"

headlines.title: 서울 아파트도 거래절벽 … 9월 3915건, 전년비 ‘ 반토막 ’
headlines.summary: 작년 6796건보다 42.4% 급감 아파트 값은 전주보다 0.09%↑ 서울 지역 아파트 거래 건수가 한 달 새 15% 가까이 감소하며 이른바, ‘거래절벽’ 상태로 진입하고 있다. 각종 대출 규제와 함께 수도권 곳곳이 토지거래허가구역으로 묶인 데다 주택담보대출 이자까지 급상승한 탓이다.

headlines.title: 전세가뭄에 부르는게 값, 서울 임대차 70% 가 ‘ 월세 ’… 집없는 설움 커...

headlines.title: 서울 아파트 평균 월세 1년새 15% 폭등
headlines.summary: 급등하는 월세에 무주택자들 신음 평균 금액 144만→166만원 상승 10%초반대 전세·매매 상승률 추월 ‘노도강’ 16%↑, 외곽 서민 ‘직격탄’ 임대료가 고공행진하는 가운데 지난 1년 동안 서울 아파트 평균 월세가 전세가 오르는 폭보다 가파르게 상승한 것으로 집계됐다.

headlines.title: “ 수도권 7만6700호 공급위해선 토지보상·교통망구축 시급 ”
headlines.summary: ■ ‘10·29 공급대책’ 전문가 제언 “합의 등 지연땐 3기 신도시 꼴” “지하철 등 해결돼야 공급 신뢰” 정부가 경기지역에 신규 공공택지 7만6700호를 공급하고 2030년까지 착공하겠다고 발표했지만, 전문가들은 3기 신도시 토지보상·광역교통망 구축 지연이 되풀이될 수 있다는 우려 섞인 전망을 내놓고 있다.

headlines.title: 가격 오른 배추, 재배면적 증가 … 내림세 무는 감소
headlines.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 진연수 기자 = 올해 가을 배추 재배면적은 늘고, 무는 줄었다. 작년 배추 가격은 오르고 무는 내리면서 재배면적에도 차이가 생긴 것으로 분석된다. 국가데이터처가 발표한 '2026년 가을배추·무 재배면적조사 결과(잠정)'에 따르면 올해 가을 배추 재배면적은 1만3천909헥타르(ha)로, 작년보다 5.5%(727ha) 늘어난 것으로 집계됐다.

headlines.title: 올해 가을배추 재배면적 5.5% 증가 … 가을무는 1.3% 감소
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 국가데이터처, 2026년 가을배추·무 재배면적조사 결과 연도별 가을배추·무 재배면적 추이(2006~2026). 국가데이터처 제공 올해 가을배추 재배면적은 지난해보다 증가한 반면 가을무는 소폭 감소한 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: 法 없어 안방 내준 ‘ K-코인결제 ’

headlines.title: 한은 “ 해외 코인카드, 과세 회피 악용 우려 ”
headlines.summary: 해외 발급 이용 현황조차 파악 못해 자료 제출 요구할 법적 근거도 미비 “해외사업자 감독 근거 마련해야” 한국은행이 해외 발급 크립토카드에 대해 자금 이동과 과세 규제 회피 수단이 될 수 있다고 국회에 보고한 것으로 확인됐다. 해외 사업자에 관련 자료를 요구하는 데에도 제도적 한계가 있어 발급·이용 현황조차 파악하지 못하고 있다는 한계도 지적됐다.

headlines.title: 결제 ‘ T+1 ’ 전환, 빨라도 늦어도 ‘ 독 ’
headlines.summary: 로드맵 초안 두고 시장 의견 수렴 외환결제 시차 줄일 인프라가 핵심 亞 주요국 동향 등 속도 조절 고심 정부가 주식 결제주기를 현행 2거래일(T+2)에서 1거래일(T+1)로 앞당기는 로드맵 초안을 마련하고 11월부터 시장 의견 수렴에 돌입한다.

headlines.title: 경기 6개 지역 그린벨트 해제… 7만6700가구 공급 , 서울은 0
headlines.summary: 정부, 김포·구리 등 신규 택지 추가 교통 대책은 없어 지자체들 반발 정부가 서울 경계에서 5㎞ 안에 있는 경기 김포·구리·하남·고양·의정부 일대 그린벨트(개발제한구역)를 풀어 7만6700가구 규모의 공공택지를 조성한다. 국토교통부는 29일 이 같은 내용의 수도권 신규 택지 후보지 6곳을 발표했다.

key_headlines.title: End of Jeonse Era: Monthly Rent Now Dominates 70% of Seoul Rental Market
key_headlines.summary: Monthly rental transactions (including partial jeonse and deposit-backed monthly rent) now account for 68.6% of all rental deals nationwide, with Seoul seeing 7 out of 10 contracts as monthly rent. Jeonse transactions have plummeted 25.7% as landlords face borrowing restrictions.

key_headlines.title: Semiconductor Boom Drives National Tax Revenue Up 95.4 Trillion Won Through September
key_headlines.summary: National tax revenue reached 385 trillion won in the first nine months of 2026, up 33% year-over-year, with corporate tax increasing 52 trillion won. The semiconductor sector's improved performance significantly boosted government revenues.

key_headlines.title: Industrial Production Hits 15.5-Year High on Semiconductor and Automotive Strength
key_headlines.summary: Third-quarter industrial production rose 1.9%, consumer spending increased 3.6% to its highest in 3.7 years, and facility investment grew 5.3%. Semiconductors and automobiles led the expansion, though concerns remain about broader economic recovery.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Trading Volume Halves Year-over-Year to 3,915 Transactions in September
key_headlines.summary: Seoul apartment transactions plummeted 42.4% to 3,915 deals in September from 6,796 a year ago, entering what analysts call a 'trading cliff' amid mortgage lending restrictions and rising interest rates.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's housing market is undergoing dramatic transformation with the accelerating decline of the jeonse system and surge in monthly rentals. Monthly rental transactions now dominate 68.6% of the market nationwide, with Seoul seeing 70% of contracts shift to monthly rent as landlords face borrowing constraints. Average Seoul apartment rents have surged 15% year-over-year to 1.66 million won, significantly outpacing jeonse and property sales price increases. Concurrently, apartment trading volumes have collapsed 42% in September amid stricter lending regulations and rising mortgage rates, signaling a potential housing market downturn despite continued price appreciation.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's economy showed mixed signals in September with industrial production and consumption rising for the first time in several months, though concerns persist about broader recovery sustainability. National tax revenue surged 95.4 trillion won year-over-year through September, reaching 385 trillion won, boosted significantly by improved corporate profits from the semiconductor sector. Employment metrics remain stable with the September jobless rate at 2.0% and working-age employment rate at 70.6%. However, monetary policy remains uncertain with central bank officials debating between rate hold and potential increases, while capital market volatility and high household debt levels continue to weigh on financial stability assessments.
sections.Financial Markets: Korean financial markets experienced significant turmoil in the third quarter, with fund assets declining 87.8 trillion won to 1.646 quadrillion won as stock market volatility intensified and the KOSPI fell nearly 20%. Bond investments gained traction amid elevated interest rates, with U.S. Treasury yields rising to 5.3% and Korean government bonds reaching 4% mid-range, attracting investors seeking safety. Asian stock markets plunged alongside U.S. Big Tech stocks amid concerns about artificial intelligence investment profitability, with the KOSPI dropping 3% and Nikkei falling 2%. Global bond yields strengthened across major economies as investors moved to safer assets, while credit risk concerns related to AI investments began spreading through financial markets.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea's industrial sector demonstrated strong momentum in September with overall production increasing 1.9%, driven primarily by semiconductor and automotive manufacturing expansions. SK Group announced executive reshuffles maintaining stability at SK Hynix while reorganizing energy leadership, signaling confidence in semiconductor operations. Industry experts highlight infrastructure gaps in power supply and talent despite Korea's global competitiveness in semiconductors, automobiles, shipbuilding, steel, displays, and content. Capital investment in new facilities increased 5.3% in September, reflecting business confidence, though concerns about supply chain dependencies on foreign components and materials remain significant.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's real estate market faces mounting headwinds with apartment transactions collapsing 42% year-over-year to 3,915 deals in September amid regulatory restrictions and rising mortgage costs. The fundamental transformation from jeonse to monthly rentals accelerated sharply, with 70% of Seoul rental contracts and 70% of provincial non-apartment rentals now monthly arrangements, creating severe affordability pressures for non-homeowners. Redevelopment and reconstruction projects remain critical supply sources, though authorities debate reforms to expedite timelines and increase floor-area ratios. New apartment supply concerns are intensifying despite continued price appreciation, with market attention turning to year-end new developments as limited inventory becomes increasingly scarce.
sections.International Economy: Global trade faces increased uncertainty from protectionist policies, with both major U.S. political parties expected to maintain Trump-era tariff frameworks, threatening Korean export-dependent industries including semiconductors, automobiles, and steel. The European Union and Canada launched a strategic alliance in response to U.S. protectionism, exploring liquefied natural gas exports, undersea cable infrastructure, and supercomputer access sharing. The Federal Reserve maintained its policy rate at 3.75-4.00% while some policymakers, including Dallas Fed President, called for at least two additional rate hikes, suggesting further monetary tightening ahead. Oil majors posted record quarterly profits exceeding $360 billion from elevated oil prices amid geopolitical tensions, while the U.S. third-quarter GDP growth of 3.4% exceeded expectations, bolstering arguments for continued rate hikes.
sections.AI & Economy: Artificial intelligence and cloud services drove strong performance for Korean IT companies, with LG CNS reporting 15% operating profit growth in Q3 on 1.66 trillion won in revenue. AI data center projects expanded significantly, including Hyundai Motor Group's 9 trillion won Saemangeum AI Valley project commencing in March 2027 and Hyosung Heavy Industries' partnership with Germany's Siemens on next-generation digital power and AI data center solutions. However, concerns about AI investment bubble spread through credit markets as Big Tech companies' massive capital expenditures and deteriorating cash flows raised profitability questions. Samsung SDS and LG CNS are pivoting toward robotics and AI transformation services, while the government is researching universal basic income for youth as AI-driven job displacement accelerates.
sections.Others: The government is actively researching youth basic income programs as AI-induced job displacement reaches concerning levels, with isolated and reclusive youth increasing from 2.4% of the youth population in 2022 to 5.2% in 2024. Big Tech companies face mounting stock market pressure from massive AI infrastructure investments that may not generate proportional returns, creating market anxiety about the sustainability of current valuation levels. The U.S. is actively promoting stablecoin adoption as infrastructure for rapid blockchain-based money circulation to support economic growth while controlling inflation. The European Union initiated safeguard investigations on hybrid vehicle imports, potentially affecting Korean automotive exports, while energy companies received recognition for advancing measurement and metering industry standards.
